claims.citation: New York Herald, 27 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bellona (Br), Dixon, London Sept 2, via Havre
4th, with mdse and 179 passengers, to Howland & Aspinwall.
The B is detained in the lower quarantine.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 29 September 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bellona, from London and Havre, at anchor in
the lower quarantine, has no sickness among her passengers
or crew. One man died at sea Sept 15 of cholera.
